01
Export your note
In Samsung Notes, choose Share or Save as file, then select Samsung Notes file (.sdocx).
02
Keep the real strokes
The converter reads the original pen data, preserving pressure and stroke shapes.
03
Zoom in. Keep going.
Download a PDF with vector handwriting, selectable typed text, and your embedded images.

    
Works with Samsung Notes .sdocx files. A screenshot or an already rasterized PDF cannot recover the original pen strokes. Typed-text fonts and line wrapping may differ slightly.
